newsitem.title: USA: Henry Schein Inc to buy dental distributors.
newsitem.headline: Henry Schein Inc to buy dental distributors.

text.p: Henry Schein Inc said Monday it entered into an agreement to acquire two dental distributors.
The distributors to be acquired are New England-based Smith Holden Inc, the longest operating dental supply company in the U.S., and Spheracom Dental Supply Inc, based in Utah.

The company said these businesses had combined 1996 sales of over $15 million, and will add over 20 field sales consultants and four equipment sales and services centers to Henry Schein Inc's existing field network.
The company said these acquisitions are expected to close within 60 days.
